author: Fextralife
description:
How to use the Outlaw Warblade - Phantom Blade Zero Weapon Guide
In this video, I want to show you guys how to use the Outlaw Blade in Phantom Blade Zero. This is probably the second confusing weapon that you might get after the Drunken Sword weapon, and I think this is a very advanced weapon that I wouldn't recommend for a first playthrough for for most people, because it's just very hard to get the rhythm of it, and I think it's actually not a bad secondary weapon, meaning like if you have another weapon that you like to use more and you just pull this one out for certain situations, then it can work really well.
